description.value: Jamonería by ARC is the retail tasting room of ARC Iberico Imports, one of Canada's leading importers of Iberian products, bringing authentic Spanish tapas and hand-carved Jamón Ibérico to Richmond's Horseshoe Way. A resident master ham carver slices premium Ibérico aged over three years tableside, and the menu extends to grilled Spanish meat cuts rarely found even in Spain. The restaurant also hosts flamenco nights, Spanish BBQ feasts, and a Sunday brunch centred on a signature tortilla.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM record as an active, open Spanish restaurant in Richmond. The contact page confirms the address as 1020-12471 Horseshoe Way (OSM omits unit 1020) and provides a phone number absent from OSM. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, takeout, or cyclist-specific amenities anywhere on the site; a patio is referenced but only in an event context with no sightlines described.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible Spanish restaurant with confirmed web presence and upcoming events. No grounds for exclusion.
